Latin word

dēserō

dēserō, dēserere, dēseruī, dēsertum

verb, third conjugation, with the accusative

abandon, desert, forsake

In this lexicon

  • abandon

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Q. Fr. 1.3.5: cum amīcī partim dēseruerint mē, partim etiam prōdiderint (Lewis & Short); Verg. A. 10.600: frātrem nē dēsere frāter (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • cum amīcī partim dēseruerint mē, partim etiam prōdiderint

    since some of my friends have abandoned me and some have even betrayed meCic. Q. Fr. 1.3.5 (Lewis & Short)
